title: [SOA] Expose Email 2 on Contact Card
summary: The Sales Order Agent app now exposes an "Email 2" field on the Contact Card, allowing users to view and edit the alternate email address that the agent stores for senders.
key_points: Adds a Contact Card page extension in the Sales Order Agent app
Makes the existing Contact "E-Mail 2" field editable for users
Allows users to inspect, correct, or clear the alternate email address
No changes to BaseApp, sender matching, or the primary email field
Purely a UI addition with no schema or permission changes
